name: DevOps CLI — Enterprise Development & Release Roadmap
description: Standardized GitHub Projects v2 template for tracking devops-cli features, sprints, milestones, and agentic workflows.

options.name: New
options.description: An item that is not yet ready

options.name: Ready
options.description: A problem statement, acceptance criteria and an answer to every key question

options.name: In Review
options.description: Its pull request is open for review and CI

options.name: Blocked
options.description: Waiting on something outside the roadmap: hardware, an upstream release or a person's decision

fields.name: Job record
fields.description: JSON the roadmap jobs write: the last value they set for each field (Release, Status, Priority, Value, Effort). No view shows it.

views.name: Sprint Kanban
views.description: Active sprint board tracking items from New to Done.

views.name: Roadmap Timeline
views.description: Release roadmap timeline grouped chronologically by release version.

views.name: Triage & Quality Table
views.description: Incoming issue and PR triage table prioritizing bugs and blockers.

views.name: Value vs Effort Priority Matrix
views.description: Items grouped by Value and sorted by Value, then Effort.
